instructions: Complete the form below. Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
stem_block:
QUARRY FIELDS LEISURE CENTRE - MEMBERSHIP FORM

Personal details
Surname: (1) ........
Address: flat (2) ........, Pennyfield Court, Pennyfield Road

Membership
Type chosen: full membership
Cost: £(3) ........ a month
(off-peak membership: weekdays only, ends at (4) ........ p.m.)
Payment: direct debit, taken on the (5) ........ of each month
To cancel: inform the centre in (6) ........, one month beforehand

Before using the gym
Induction with an instructor: lasts roughly (7) ........ minutes
What to bring: a towel, plus indoor (8) ........

Other information
Classes: booked online or through the app - not by (9) ........
Climbing wall: shut until the end of (10) ........

items.explanation: The surname is spelled out letter by letter in the audio: K-I-R-K-E-G-A-A-R-D. It can only be asked because it is spelled out, as the spelling is hard to guess.

items.prompt: Address: flat (2) ........, Pennyfield Court, Pennyfield Road
items.evidence: It's flat nine, Pennyfield Court, and that's on Pennyfield Road.
items.explanation: The customer first says flat two, then immediately corrects it: that was their old address; the new address is flat nine.

items.evidence: The full one is thirty-eight pounds a month and gets you in whenever we're open.
items.explanation: Full membership is thirty-eight pounds a month; the twenty-six-pound option is the off-peak membership, which the customer is not taking.

items.prompt: (off-peak membership: weekdays only, ends at (4) ........ p.m.)
items.evidence: It was five until the spring, but it's four now.
items.explanation: The poster outside says five, but the adviser says the poster is out of date: off-peak membership now ends at four o'clock.

items.prompt: Payment: direct debit, taken on the (5) ........ of each month
items.evidence: It comes out by direct debit on the first of the month.
items.explanation: Payment is taken on the first of the month; the fifteenth was the old arrangement, and everyone was switched to the first in January.

items.prompt: To cancel: inform the centre in (6) ........, one month beforehand
items.evidence: you just give us a month's notice in writing if you want to stop
items.explanation: The minimum contract period has been removed; a month's written notice is now enough to cancel membership.

items.prompt: Induction with an instructor: lasts roughly (7) ........ minutes
items.explanation: The customer was told an hour, but since the fitness assessment is now a separate appointment, the induction tour now takes forty minutes.

items.prompt: What to bring: a towel, plus indoor (8) ........
items.evidence: Bring a towel and a pair of indoor trainers
items.explanation: Because the studio floor has been redone, outdoor shoes are not allowed in; along with a towel, indoor trainers are required.

items.prompt: Classes: booked online or through the app - not by (9) ........
items.evidence: we stopped taking bookings over the telephone
items.explanation: Classes can only be booked through the website or the app; phone bookings have been discontinued.

items.prompt: Climbing wall: shut until the end of (10) ........
items.evidence: That reopens at the end of April.
items.explanation: The climbing wall is closed because its holds are being replaced; it reopens at the end of April.
